_doc: The toy forge.json the suites build their world from (tests/sandbox.py seed()): every integration on but jev (its setup.py is a private skill a stranger's copy lacks), a few neutral skill tables so the generators have something to apply, and nothing of anyone's machine. Same shape as examples/forge.json. The names under skill_keep are made up: toy-common is the one skill every trimmed profile keeps, and app.claude.json is the one profile that takes the gsd-* baseline by full replace. A suite that needs another table writes its own copy over this one.
